code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (pH 6.9, low O₂ saturation and pO₂), consistent with acute respiratory failure and uncompensated metabolic/respiratory acidosis. There is normocytic, hypochromic anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoalbuminemia, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or systemic illness. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are warranted.
